paragraphs: In Avodah Zarah 18b he said, “Anyone who mocks brings destruction upon the world.” Hyman reports another reading, R' Tanchum bar Chanilai, also found in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Chanilai bar Chanilai and Tanchum bar Chanilai are the reported variants.

The whole Davidson paragraph fully writes Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai with the quoted teaching. The Tanchum reading remains Hyman’s report; Dikdukei Soferim was not freshly collated, so that proposed personal title remains R'. The inherited note and both name forms remain unchanged.
